title: 多语言量化税：边缘小型语言模型中的结构崩溃与类型学脆弱性
summary: 该研究对Gemma 4和Qwen 3.5架构进行4位量化的零样本多语言评估，发现量化导致低资源语言表示崩溃、母语保护悖论、领域特定遗忘及量化抵抗等现象，揭示了预训练不平等。
summary_en: This study evaluates 4-bit quantization on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 across eight typologically diverse languages, revealing representational collapse, home language fragility paradox, domain-specific forgetting, and quantization resistance, exposing pretraining inequalities.
